resources.string:
EcoMind is an educational sustainability project for students and families. Activities, educational materials and progress features support learning about environmental habits.

Your account
Use your own account information and keep your password private. Your email is used for account verification and password recovery. Sign out when you finish using a shared device.

Participation
Complete activities honestly and treat other participants with respect. Points, streaks and achievements represent participation in EcoMind; they do not certify measured environmental savings.

Privacy
Avoid sharing sensitive information in community posts or activity evidence. Do not share another person’s personal information without permission.

Terms and privacy information are pending review by the project team.
